answer_1.quote: We show that using only input sequences (without ground truth output sequences) from multiple NLP task datasets, a pre-trained LLM is able to improve performances for both in-domain and out-of-domain tasks.

answer_2.quote: We observe significant improvement, comparing self-consistency versus LMSI with self-consistency: +7.7% on GSM8K, +4.8% on DROP, +4.4% on OpenBookQA, and +4.5% on ANLI-A3.
